item.tib: dpal bo bdun bsgrub kyi sgrib sbyangs 'phrul gyi me long dril bsgrub
item.coloph: bder gshegs thugs kyi rtsa rgyud las/ sgrib sbyangs gsang ba'i dril bsgrub (sgrub) ces bya ba/ dran pa nam mkha'i thugs kyi bcud/ skal ldan khyod la bsnyan (snyan) du brgyud (rgyud) /gsang sbas thabs la mkhas par gyis/ u ya ag tham sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya/ dad ldan grogs po'i rkyen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rnams la mthol lo bshags/ bka' skyongs bsrung (skyong srung) ma rnams la bzod pa gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun rig 'dzin sa thob shog mkha' 'gro ma'i (mas) bdag mi shig rdo rje rtsal la brgyud pa dge legs 'phel//
